answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the ridge graph and each risks its bond. Because the raven release is recorded with every signature, the ember audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 4 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm of 22 pays that 25 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
